result.edit: In the case item for ABC=3'b001, change Y from 0 to 1 so the combinational output matches the expected value at the first divergence cycle.
result.replacement_rtl:
module JG3(ABC,X,Y);
	
	input [2:0] ABC;
	
	output X, Y;
	reg X, Y;
	
	always@(ABC)
    
        

case(ABC)
3'b000 : begin X = 0; Y = 1; end
3'b001 : begin X = 0; Y = 1; end
3'b010 : begin X = 0; Y = 0; end
3'b011 : begin X = 0; Y = 0; end
3'b100 : begin X = 0; Y = 0; end
3'b101 : begin X = 0; Y = 0; end
3'b110 : begin X = 1; Y = 0; end
3'b111 : begin X = 1; Y = 0; end
default :;
endcase
        

	
endmodule
